## 

Configuring Push Templates

 [Image: Screenshot of Push Template Configuration] 
Screenshot of Push Template Configuration

To configure a new RCS template:

- Go to Tools > Templates.

- Click Add New Template.

- Enter a Name for the template. Only lower case letters and underscores are allowed in this field. Do not use spaces in the template name.

- Select the Channel as Push.

- Enter the details for:

- Title

- Expiry In Seconds

- Click one of the options below based on the type of device or OS configuration:

- Android

- iOS

- Webpush

- Interactions

- Select Lock this template to prevent other users to make changes.

- Click Save.

## 📘
Note

Only the configured data from the earlier steps will be considered when a template ID is passed in the messaging API. The messaging API will not take into consideration any extra parameters that are sent in separately.
